thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — Elevated p50/p95 latency on /v1/generate across eu-west-1. Error rate steady ~0.8% and bursts of 5xxs. Paging sam and olivia.

sam: on it, taking pager. starting initial triage now. any customer-facing impact?

olivia: quick check — dashboards show tail latency spikes align with batcher queue growth at the inference tier. some routes hit fallback to smaller model. customers on dedicated capacity unaffected.

rahul: FYI we have a canary deploy of a new KV-cache optimization rolled out 45m ago to prod-gpu-3. Could be related.

sam: ok pausing the canary rollout for prod-gpu-3. rahul can you revert the flag?

rahul: reverting now. command: `kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/inf-runtime KV_CACHE_OPT=off --record`

devops-bot: deploy/inf-runtime env updated: KV_CACHE_OPT=off on prod-gpu-3 (revision v2026.03.02).

jess: good. i'll watch the batcher metrics and queue depth. if it drops we call containment.

sam: switching traffic for heavy routes to fallback-model-small for 10m to reduce latency while we stabilize. added rate-limit 90% for non-critical routes.

maria: heads-up — two enterprise customers reported degraded token throughput in support tickets. raising to account teams.

olivia: observed queue depth halved after revert. p95 from 1.8s -> 0.34s in 6 minutes. 5xxs trending down. looks resolved for now, leaving mitigation measures for 20m.

sam: agree. marking incident as contained. filing follow-ups: root cause triage, rollback gating for cache flags, improved smoke tests for canary. want post-incident review later this week.

rahul: initial root cause notes: new cache eviction path caused lock contention in hot shard which blocked KV lookup worker threads under certain seqlen distributions. will prepare repro and PR.

jess: action item — add a canary smoke that runs representative prompt shapes that exercise long-prefix generation. I'll own that.

maria: action item — coordinate customer comms: send summary to impacted accounts and note mitigations. I can draft.

sam: schedule: propose post-incident review (retro) Friday 10:30am PT, 45m. proposal: quick timeline, RCA, action items, owners, plus a 30m brown-bag follow-up next week for distributed systems team to walk through the cache design and learnings.

olivia: Friday works. invite eng, infra, SRE, product and support reps. pls add runbook gaps list to agenda.

rahul: i'll upload repro logs and the failing trace snippets to the incident doc before EOD.

devops-bot: reminder set for meeting: Friday 10:30am PT (45m) — channel: #eng-oncall.

sam: assigning owners here — rahul -> RCA + repro PR, jess -> canary smoke tests, maria -> customer comms + support follow-up, olivia -> runbook updates + rollout gating checklist. will check back tomorrow for progress.

maria: drafting customer note now. will ping for review when ready.

jess: quick question — do we want a guard in the pipeline to block cache-flag flips without a smoke run?

olivia: yes. add gating: `smoke_ok == true` AND `perf_delta < 10%` before promoting flag. add to rollout doc.

rahul: noted. adding script to canary pipeline to run the new smoke suite and emit `smoke_ok`.

sam: one more org learning item — brown-bag topic: "KV cache eviction patterns and safe rollout strategies". rahul + jess to present. propose Tuesday 11am PT next week.

maria: i'll coordinate calendar invites and include the incident summary + customer impact notes.

olivia: thanks everyone. good work containing quickly. we'll capture the runbook changes in the retro and make sure the gating is enforced. :thumbsup:

sam: closing the on-call handoff for now. please add any new items to the incident doc.

devops-bot: Incident thread closed for paging. Post-incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1955555555 (will be populated). Next steps: RCA draft due +48h, retro scheduled, PRs linked.

maria: RSVP for brown-bag? I'll need headcount to book a room for hybrid.

olivia: +1, bringing snacks for the hybrid room.

rahul: I'll present the cache perf graphs. RSVP yes.

jess: yes, will demo the smoke tests.

sam: added to calendar. thanks all.

(END)
